There is no dedicated refactor/simplify slash prompt currently.

What is available instead:
1. Closest prompts:
1. vscode-config/prompts/plan.prompt.md
2. vscode-config/prompts/codeReview.prompt.md
3. vscode-config/prompts/iterate.prompt.md

2. Dedicated refactoring tool:
1. mcp_pylance_mcp_s_pylanceInvokeRefactoring

That tool supports these refactor/simplify actions:
1. source.unusedImports
2. source.convertImportFormat
3. source.convertImportStar
4. source.convertImportToModule
5. source.renameShadowedStdlibImports
6. source.addTypeAnnotation
7. source.fixAll.pylance

If you want, I can run one of those refactorings on a specific Python file now.
